title: Green Cosmic Oracle
description: A green-skinned woman with three eyes and red irises is depicted from the shoulders up, wearing an ornate crown of flames and yellow flowers. She holds a transparent orb in her left hand containing a red sun, two crescent faces, a tiny astronaut figure, and purple lavender, set against a black space background with geometric patterns, a red planet, and swirling galaxies.
